summary: Verified end-to-end the new Plaid bank-linking integration on a fresh test user. All 7 new pytest cases pass (link_token, exchange+sync via Plaid sandbox public_token helper, status secrecy of access_token_enc, encrypted Mongo storage of plaid txns with amount_enc/description_enc/source='plaid'/worksheet_id 'plaid:{item_id}', disconnect removes item + its txns, sync-with-no-items 400). Regression suite still green (29/29 across backend_test.py + test_accounting.py). Frontend: Import Data page renders the three cards (upload-dropzone, gdrive-card, plaid-card); clicking 'Connect Bank' (data-testid=connect-bank-btn) calls /api/plaid/create_link_token (200, token starts with link-sandbox-) and the Plaid-hosted iframe opens (cdn.plaid.com modal, 'Sandbox mode' banner visible). No JS errors. Dashboard/regression flows unaffected.

minor.issue: Sync error path raises HTTPException(400) with raw Plaid e.body (a string). Fine for debugging but consider parsing into structured detail.
Projection excludes _id, access_token_enc and cursor — good. created_at/last_synced are returned (not sensitive). Validated no secret leakage.

Plaid SDK calls (item_public_token_exchange, transactions_sync) are synchronous inside async endpoints — works correctly under load test but blocks the event loop; consider asyncio.to_thread for production.

issues: Console warning 'The Plaid link-initialize.js script was embedded more than once' — caused by usePlaidLink re-initializing when linkToken state changes. Not blocking. Consider memoizing or reset to null only after open() resolves.

action_items: (Optional) Wrap Plaid SDK sync calls (item_public_token_exchange, transactions_sync) in asyncio.to_thread to avoid blocking the FastAPI event loop.
(Optional) Silence the duplicate Plaid link-initialize.js console warning by guarding linkToken state to a single initialization.
critical_code_review_comments: plaid_service.py: _sync_item correctly uses cursor pagination + upsert dedupe on plaid_transaction_id — re-running sync is idempotent.
_map_transaction: positive Plaid amount => expense, negative => income, stored as abs() — matches Plaid contract and matches the manual transactions model.
register_plaid_routes encloses _sync_item by closure but redeclares db parameter — harmless shadowing.
Disconnect deletes only transactions where worksheet_id == f'plaid:{item_id}' — good scoping; manual & upload txns are preserved.
/api/plaid/status correctly projects out _id and access_token_enc; verified in tests that the access token field is never returned.

Frontend Upload.jsx PlaidSection: setLinkToken(null) inside onSuccess finally block could fire before usePlaidLink finishes — the duplicate-script warning surfaces because of token re-init; consider key-based remount or a single-shot token.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested Plaid flow (link-token call + iframe launch verified; iframe Sandbox UI completion is external/non-automatable as flagged)

test_credentials: admin@finsight.com / admin123. Fresh test users TEST_plaid_*@example.com auto-registered in pytest fixture. Plaid sandbox client_id/secret pulled from /app/backend/.env.
seed_data_creation: Fresh per-test users register via /api/auth/register; the Plaid sandbox helper (POST sandbox.plaid.com/sandbox/public_token/create with institution_id ins_109508) deterministically produced ~16 transactions imported on initial exchange (the sandbox returns synchronously, so no retry loop was needed in this run). After tests the fresh user has its Plaid item disconnected; the admin user's prior Plaid linkage is left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Plaid tests at /app/backend/tests/test_plaid.py register a fresh user per module and exercise the full sandbox flow. The Plaid Link iframe is launched in-browser by the React app but the modal interactions (selecting First Platypus Bank + user_good/pass_good) cannot be reliably automated via Playwright because they live in a cross-origin cdn.plaid.com iframe. For deterministic backend testing of exchange/sync, use the sandbox public_token helper at https://sandbox.plaid.com/sandbox/public_token/create directly (no UI needed). Admin already has a prior Plaid item + invoice + sample data; spin up TEST_plaid_*@example.com fresh users for clean state. Encrypted DB fields are amount_enc/description_enc (Fernet via security.encrypt_value); plaintext 'amount'/'description' should NEVER appear in Mongo for plaid-sourced rows.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. The single console warning 'Plaid link-initialize.js script was embedded more than once' is cosmetic and originates from the react-plaid-link hook re-initializing when setLinkToken updates while usePlaidLink is already mounted. Mitigation: render the PlaidSection's usePlaidLink only when linkToken is non-null (e.g. extract a sub-component keyed by linkToken so the hook mounts once per token).
